messages.text:
Hey!
I read your description and it felt like an amazing fit!
My partner and I (mid 20s) are currently looking for a place to rent and wanted to introduce ourselves 😊
We’re a pretty easygoing couple who like a clean, relaxed home and are always mindful of shared spaces. We’re reliable with rent and respectful of other people’s routines and privacy.
My girlfriend is a hairdresser (which has it's benefits) and is super social, she knows how to have a fun time! giving you guys a haircut or two. 
We have lived with roommates before, so we know what is expected of us.

Hi! We're doing inspections tonight at 6:45pm.
Would you like to come?
📍 41 Park St, Spring Hill QLD 4000
Mathis will be there to assist you.
Message when you arrive: +61 411 590 261
